title: A Reproducible Protocol for Resource-Aware Predictive Process Monitoring: Compact Baselines, a Simulator Blueprint, and Pitfalls

contributions.purpose: 提供防泄漏可复现 PPM 协议
contributions.mechanism: 按案例开始时间的时序切分(70/15/15)、仅训练集归一化、固定种子、自动产物记录
contributions.evaluation: 确定性可一键复现(定性)
contributions.source_quote: A leakage-safe, deterministic protocol with chronological case splits, train-only normalization, fixed seeds, and automatic artifact logging.

contributions.purpose: 发布紧凑透明的下一活动预测基线
contributions.mechanism: LSTM(emb64/hidden128/dropout0.2)在 BPI2012/BPI2017/Road Traffic 三日志
contributions.source_quote: Baseline next-activity results are strong (Top-3 0.987–0.994; Top-1 0.757–0.833), exposing systematic confusions that motivate resource context.

contributions.purpose: 给出资源感知仿真器蓝图与指标
contributions.mechanism: 每资源多项式 logistic 策略+轻量离散事件仿真,定义全局下一事件/工作量 MAPE/每资源下一任务精度
contributions.evaluation: 仅蓝图,本版未跑端到端仿真结果
contributions.source_quote: A released simulator blueprint with per-resource multinomial policies and lightweight discrete-event simulation... we do not claim state-of-the-art accuracy nor report end-to-end simulator metrics in this version.

contributions.purpose: 记录实践中的陷阱与检查清单
contributions.mechanism: 生命周期配对在部分轨迹下不可靠、不平衡感知回退
contributions.evaluation: 宏 F1 仅 0.474–0.587 显著落后于 Top-3≈0.99(稀有活动受损)
contributions.source_quote: Pitfalls and checklists observed in practice (e.g., lifecycle pairing under partial traces; imbalance-aware back-offs).

self_declared_provenance.quote: Unlike prior case-centric LSTMs [2,3,8], our work positions a reproducible bridge: retain the case-centric predictor as a modular component, but incorporate per-resource policies and a discrete-event simulator for concurrent execution.

notes: 诚实自限的协议/蓝图论文,四条自声明贡献。核心红旗(非实证类适配问题):其"资源感知"卖点(C3 仿真器)只有蓝图、本版未做端到端评估——核心主张未被验证。Trade-off:宏 F1 0.474–0.587 远低于 Top-3≈0.99,稀有活动被牺牲。作者明确"不声称 SOTA"。复现性做得好,但贡献偏薄,reject。
